gloss: to gush out; to spring forth; to well up

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {湧|わ}き{出|で}ていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to gush out; to spring forth; to well up
definitions.explanation: For liquid (especially water) to emerge forcefully from a source. Also used figuratively for emotions, ideas, or energy that arise spontaneously and abundantly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{泉|いずみ}→泉：01787_izumi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{湧|わ}き{出|で}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Water is gushing out from the spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{湧|わ}き{出|で}てくる。
examples.english: Ideas keep springing forth one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地中|ちちゅう}→地中：12135_chichuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{湧|わ}き{出|で}る⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: It's famous as a town where hot springs well up from underground.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{湧|わ}き{出|で}る
- No direct transitive pair

ASPECT (ている):
{湧|わ}き{出|で}て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing action - water is actively flowing out.

COMPOUND VERB STRUCTURE:
⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧ (to well up) + ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to come out) = to gush/spring forth

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{湧|わ}き{出|で}る - water gushes out
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{湧|わ}き{出|で}る - hot spring wells up
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{湧|わ}き{出|で}る - tears well up
- ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{湧|わ}き{出|で}る - ideas spring forth
- ⟦{活力|かつりょく}→活力：05525_katsuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{湧|わ}き{出|で}る - vitality wells up

USAGE:
Often used metaphorically for emotions, creativity, or energy that arises spontaneously and abundantly, as if from an internal spring.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧ - to well up (simpler form)
- ⟦{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す→噴き出す：29265_fukidasu⟧ - to spout, to gush (more forceful)
- {溢|あふ}れ{出|で}る - to overflow, to pour out
